title: Hom-side component data
statement: The Hom-side chain, projection, derived comparison and resolution-model fields admit simultaneous choices.

proof.text: Take the normalized sheaf-Hom comparison eta, the K-injective chain comparison chi, and the derived comparison delta from podReindexing_hom_resolution_model. Integer-indexed products are preserved by podReindexing_resolution_preservation. The section formula for eta implies its joint naturality: after evaluation at any slice arrow and section, both paths are b composed with f composed with a.

Package eta as a natural isomorphism between the uncurried sheaf-Hom bifunctors. Apply sheafHomComplexComparison to the additive, product-preserving reindexing functor. This gives the chain comparison for all complexes, without a K-injectivity restriction, and its exact product-projection formula.

For a K-injective target, the new chain comparison and chi have identical composites with every Hom-product projection. Hom-complex projection extensionality in each degree therefore identifies their chain maps. The section formula for eta converts the new projection formula to the required slice-section equation. Substitute the equality of chain maps into the existing delta resolution-model equation, and assemble the four ComparisonCoreHomData fields.

theorem comparison_core_hom_data_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt]
    (s : Option ℕ) (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY) :
    Nonempty (ComparisonCoreHomData l E g s SX SY TX TY)
